title: skills-sh-jezweb-claude-skills-claude-agent-sdk
summary: # Changelog ## 0.3.319 - Added MCP task support in SDK sessions (not on Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry): with `CLAUDE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TASKS=1` and streaming input, an MCP task runs in the background with `task_type` `"mcp_task"` - Fixed the OpenTelemetry `claude_code.session.count` metric counting `prewarm()` processes that were never claimed; a pre-started process now counts once, when `SpareProcess.claim()` succeeds - Fixed `session_writes_lost` listing the wrong session in `transcript_session_ids` after `/clear` in a session resumed from a transcript file outside the projects folder - Improved `deleteSession()` to reject with `ENOTEMPTY` if the session's folder could not be fully deleted - Changed `session_writes_lost` to be sent only when the CLI exits 0; a run that ends on an error result now gets only the stderr line - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.319 ## 0.3.318 - Added an optional `credential_expires_at` field to result messages: when the stored claude.ai sign-in in use ends
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
source_url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-typescript/main/CHANGELOG.md
